_comment: Order alerts (the order-watch service). Split out of netsuite_customers.json 2026-09-21; still read through app.netsuite_payload.load_refs().
_comment_alerts: Order alerts (app.alerts, Ritchie 2026-09-16): outliers the accounting digest must NOT carry, emailed to the order.alerts group (env ALERT_RECIPIENTS, same sender) -- one email per 15-min poll, grouped by issue, subject carries the order numbers, body = clickable order # (CRSTL PO view) + issue + known fix, plus a 'still open' line. Issue asn_missing: a non-voided ShipStation label in the HD Dropship store (dropship_store_id) older than asn_missing_after_minutes with no 856 in CRSTL (two misses on 2026-09-16 alone: 538858722, 538871711). lookback_days bounds the ShipStation shipments read. Issue packed_unshipped: a Finale sale shipment still PACKED more than packed_unshipped_after_hours (24) after it was packed -- until it is shipped the order does not invoice, and nothing else says so; packed_go_live_after is a positive floor on the pack date so switching it on never alerts the whole history. NOTE: a flat 24h also catches DSD shipments waiting on a pickup the ASN scheduled days out. One receipt per shipment (tracking.alerts); asn_missing resolves when the 856 appears or the label is voided, packed_unshipped when the shipment is no longer packed. enabled=false = dry runs only. Issue asn_rejected / invoice_rejected (Ritchie 2026-09-24): HD's OWN verdict, from the EDI 864 error messages CRSTL mapped for our account on 2026-09-24 (app.edi_rejects) -- an ASN reject (E114 duplicate ASN #, E712 duplicate UCC128, E573 TMS shipment ID, E582 bill of lading, IB03 line total) or an invoice reject (ED44 QST without GST, ED01 vendor number missing, E332/E336). edi_reject_go_live_after is a positive floor on the 864's own date (ET): with it unset NOTHING is read or reported, so switching this on never emails the 27-notice backlog (Dec 2025 - Aug 2026, all of it already dealt with). Set to 2026-09-24 -- future rejections only. Reported as events, not open conditions: emailed once and closed in the same run, because nothing on our side ever says a rejection was put right; if it is still wrong HD sends another 864 and that one alerts afresh. Issue catalogue_near_limit (Ritchie 2026-09-21): not an order -- once Finale's product catalogue reaches product_warn_at (checked once a day), because invoicing reads the whole catalogue in one list that stops at 10,000 (5,384 on 2026-09-21; each blind line adds thousands of cut sizes). Clears when back under.
